newsitem.title: USA: N.J. says happy with bids on $330 mln tunnel plan.
newsitem.headline: N.J. says happy with bids on $330 mln tunnel plan.

text.p: New Jersey officials said bids received for building an Atlantic City tunnel show the project can be completed for $330 million.
The bids received Tuesday ranged from $191 million from New York-based Yonkers Contracting Co to $330 million from New Jersey-based Schiavone Construction Co.
Transportation Commissioner Jack Haley said the low bid was in line with the state's own cost estimates.
The tunnel would connect the city's Marina District and developer Steve Wynn's proposed Mirage Resort to the Atlantic City Expressway.
Donald Trump, who campaigned vigorously against the project, argued that the total cost could go as high as $500 million.
Gov. Christine Whitman said in a statement she was pleased the bids fell within the budget New Jersey had approved for the project.
"These projects will generate thousands of permanent and construction jobs and tens of millions of dollars in yearly revenues for the city and the state," Whitman said.
The state and Mirage Resorts Inc are financing the tunnel jointly, with $220 million expected from New Jersey and $110 million from Mirage.
